groups.comparison: Fresh P16 tactical combat configuration, all 344 lines. This authored document contains numeric measurements, fixed section keys, and seven named BodyPart hitbox entries; no carried Boolean mode or discriminator with conditional fields appears. Continuous tuning axes remain independent. Preserve legitimate zero unarmed precision, gait bounce/flight apex, bouncy transmission, and first-run-release foot rotation speed. Signed gamepad look scale, visual Y offset and terrain toe-contact clearance are intentional signed quantities; do not force all values positive. Locomotion/continuity 64 Hz, playback/pose 30 Hz and calibration interval count 256 have different owners; numeric equality does not justify merging clocks. Authored displacement profile is ordered history, not a finite choice enum. Rag-doll body segment labels, locomotion modes and body-part names require their actual configuration schema and consumers before propagation conclusions. No semantic-state defect established from configuration alone, and no admission/operation acceptance transferred from default valid numbers.
